ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: Since the pyre they can't stand the smell of smoke. It only troubles them within a few steps of an open fire: give them a seat at the table, a bed and work away from campfires, hearths, braziers and torches. It fades in a season or so.
ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.act: Keep them away from open fires
